anomalies.observed: C1 on the EPD_Driver sheet is drawn as 0.1 uF / 16 V.
anomalies.expected: The design specification calls for C1 to be 1 uF / 25 V in the EPD driver capacitor set.
anomalies.impact: The EPD power/charge-pump decoupling is reduced compared with the intended value, which can increase display-rail noise or affect boost stability.

anomalies.observed: C2 on the EPD_Driver sheet is drawn as 10 uF / 6.3 V.
anomalies.expected: The design specification calls for C2 to be 1 uF / 6.3 V, matching the G1-specific reference value.
anomalies.impact: The EPD input/filter capacitance is ten times the intended value, which can change boost startup, inrush and loop behavior for the e-paper supply.

parsed.summary: The schematic matches most of the specified architecture, but two EPD-driver capacitor values deviate from the intended design: C1 is 0.1 uF/16 V instead of 1 uF/25 V, and C2 is 10 uF/6.3 V instead of 1 uF/6.3 V. These value errors can affect EPD boost stability and display-rail noise.
